title: Prove sharp binary separator cost for even-subset cubes
body:
This is a scoped negative result with an attaining binary construction. For every even `k >= 2`, put `N = 2^(k-1)`. One parity cross block of the inherited even-subset kernel has scalar rank `N - binomial(k,k/2)/2`, but a decomposition into scalar rank-one factors with separate orthogonal nondegenerate binary endpoint hulls needs exactly `N` factors and total endpoint dimension `2*k*N`. Row stars attain both minima. At `k=4`, this distinguishes scalar rank five from eight factors and dimension charge 64.

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/018fc6258bd3f30f79daee83ca88592c02b72729/research/even-subset-separator-floor/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/018fc6258bd3f30f79daee83ca88592c02b72729/research/even-subset-separator-floor/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/018fc6258bd3f30f79daee83ca88592c02b72729/research/even-subset-separator-floor/verify.py), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/018fc6258bd3f30f79daee83ca88592c02b72729/research/even-subset-separator-floor/SOURCES.json) specify the class and evidence. The proof covers arbitrary real or complex scalar coefficients, cancellation, and extra orthogonal ambient coordinates. It charges both endpoint dimensions separately for each factor. Shared chronological carriers, operator-valued factors and changed encoded inputs are outside this class.

This result does not improve the complete kappa calculation or change the selected frontier. It closes a specific route from low scalar rank to a cheap separate-frame side computation. The attaining hulls do not establish the stronger historical orthonormal-residual conditions, native Gaussian phases, physical transport, dirty restoration, or a complete recursive invoice. The full even-subset supplier remains open.

The base is `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. All four consumed source documents are pinned there; there are no external PR-head dependencies. With Python 3.12 and its standard library, run from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/even-subset-separator-floor --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/even-subset-separator-floor
```

Expected output includes:

```text
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
PASS_EVEN_SUBSET_SEPARATOR_FLOOR
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/even-subset-separator-floor outcome=negative-result
```

The registered normal and optimized checks passed on CPython 3.12.14. Direct normal and optimized checks also passed on CPython 3.14.7. Exact checks include rational ranks at `k=2,4,6`, Walsh spectra through `k=12`, all 65,025 nonempty support pairs at `k=4`, and a separate enumeration of all 374 ambient binary subspaces at `k=2`. The row-star reconstruction, minimum hulls and small star-readable target sets pass. Eight controls reject excluded odd/zero dimensions, a missing constant coordinate, orthogonality without separation, degenerate hulls, a missing hull partner, a wrong coefficient and a missing row star.

Publication-byte and committed-export checks passed for all 11 package/input files. The checked export passed normal and optimized direct replay with Git absent from `PATH`, read-only payload files and unchanged hashes. The optional source-history preflight did not pass because the shared repository is shallow; the pinned source base is the literal parent of this publication commit. Hosted CI, Lean, native compilation and a selected-construction replay were not run. The written all-k proof and the author-side Codex review are not independent human review or formal verification.

The kernel and full-star support spans are from [PR #2225](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2225), by Cinna Davis (@1337isnot1337), with substantial Codex assistance; see the [pinned proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/even-subset-dyadic-kernels/PROOF.md) and [author notice](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/even-subset-dyadic-kernels/README.md). Its subset/compiler ancestry, including Zhihao Chen, retains credit. No new kernel is claimed here.

Douglas Colkitt's [preserved parity-side research](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/docs/research/parity-side.md) supplies the prior common-span obstruction. [PR #920](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/920), prepared for Arnav with substantial Codex assistance, distinguishes separating hulls from the stronger historical residual interface; see its [pinned research note](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/complex-parity-frames-seed35/README.md). The new claim is the sharp factor-count and endpoint-dimension theorem for this cube. The scalar spectrum supports it; the star-readable formula is an inherited-geometry corollary. Prepared for Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; new work is Apache-2.0.
